text: dsh-crop-zoom 是一个为 DSH 提供图像区域放大工具的插件，也可作为命令行使用。它注册 crop_zoom 工具，让模型指定本地图片中的一个或多个矩形区域，按整数倍和所选插值核裁剪放大，并输出 PNG；多个区域可拼成带几何标注的图片。支持预览坐标换算、自动缩放和分别输出，适合检查截图中的小字、表格或状态标签。处理依赖本机 sharp，不配置 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-crop-zoom adds a DSH tool and CLI to crop and enlarge local image regions. It applies a scale and kernel to rectangles, then writes PNGs or a labeled sheet. Preview coordinates can map to the source. Useful for small screenshot text; processing is local and needs no API key or external service.
截图里的小字太糊了，能先裁出来放大再让模型看吗？
想把一张图里的几个局部放大后拼到一张图上检查。
我在缩小预览图上框了区域，怎样按原图坐标裁剪放大？
dsh-crop-zoom 的功能「裁剪并放大图像区域」：调用 crop_zoom 工具或命令行，传入本地图片路径和矩形坐标，可对最多八个区域按指定或自动倍数放大，再将结果写为 PNG 单图或标注拼图。
dsh-crop-zoom 的功能「命令行处理图片」：运行 crop-zoom 并提供图片、一个或多个区域及缩放选项，可选择插值核、预览图宽度和输出位置；命令行调用同一裁剪引擎并打印生成文件路径。

dsh-crop-zoom README · dsh-crop-zoom：**Magnify a region of an image so small text becomes readable.**

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (`dsh`) plugin that registers a
`crop_zoom` tool, plus the same engine as a standalone CLI.
[中文说明 →](README.zh-CN.md)

- Local image processing only — no network, no model call, no OCR engine.
- One dependency: `sharp` (libvips), loaded lazily so a missing native build can never stop the harness from booting.
- Node ≥ 22. MIT.

---

dsh-crop-zoom README · The problem this solves：A 1920×1080 screenshot does not reach a model at 1920×1080. It is downscaled on the way
in, so a 10–11px item label arrives with its strokes already fused — and re-reading the
same screenshot cannot bring those pixels back.

Four readings off one status screen, every one of them wrong in the same way:

dsh-crop-zoom README · The problem this solves：| Printed | Came back as | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `03重型盔` | `D3重型盔` | at 11px the `0` and the `D` share one left stem |
| `BT6重型` | `B16重型` | the `T` welds itself onto the `B` before it |
| `1000戰地包` | `100D戰地包` | four digits merge into three plus a letter |
| `鎏影權鋒` | `盜影權杖` | the 金 under 鎏 collapses into something 皿-shaped |

dsh-crop-zoom README · The problem this solves：Those characters are perfectly legible once the region is cropped out and upscaled.
Doing that *before* the text is read is the only reliable order of operations, and it
costs far less than pushing the whole screenshot through again.

dsh-crop-zoom README · Install as a dsh plugin：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-crop-zoom     # from a registry
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-crop-zoom   # from a local checkout
```

Then restart the app. The model gains a `crop_zoom` tool, re-sent with every request.

dsh-crop-zoom README · Install as a CLI：```bash
npm install -g dsh-crop-zoom
crop-zoom -i shot.png -r 1178,588,64,24 -s 16 -o label.png
```

dsh-crop-zoom README · Using the tool：```
1 file written from C:\shots\raid.png (1920x1080), kernel bicubic.

#1  source 1178,588 64x24  x12  -> 768x288
#2  source 1444,373 96x42  x12  -> 1152x504

dsh-crop-zoom README · Parameters：| Name | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | — | Absolute path to the source image. Required. |
| `regions` | array | — | 1–8 regions, in sheet order. Required. Each is `{x, y, width, height, label?}` in **source** pixels. |
| `scale` | integer | — | Integer magnification, 1–16. Omit to derive it from `target`. |
| `target` | integer | `1600` | With no `scale`, magnify until the region's longer edge reaches this many pixels, capped at 16×. |
| `mode` | enum | `bicubic` | `bicubic` \| `nearest` \| `lanczos` \| `mitchell`. |
| `sheet` | boolean | `true` | Stack every region into one labelled PNG. `false` writes one file per region. |
| `outPath` | string | temp dir | Where to write; must end in `.png`. |
| `previewWidth` | integer | — | Set this when the coordinates were measured on a downscaled preview: pass that preview's pixel width and every coordinate is rescaled to the source automatically. |

dsh-crop-zoom README · Parameters：`bicubic` preserves glyph outlines and is the right default. `nearest` replicates whole
pixels, which is what separates a `0` from a `D` — the two are complements, so when a
character still will not resolve, look at it both ways.

dsh-crop-zoom README · CLI：```
crop-zoom -i <image> -r <x,y,w,h> [-r <x,y,w,h> ...] [options]

-i, --image <path>        Source image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF or GIF)
  -r, --region <x,y,w,h>    Region to magnify; repeat up to 8 times

dsh-crop-zoom README · How it works：1. Decode the source once into memory. Regions are bounded against the *display* size
   (after EXIF rotation), so an upright photo is cropped where it looks upright.
2. `extract` each region, then `resize` by an integer factor with the selected kernel —
   integer scaling avoids resampling artefacts on exactly the strokes you are trying to read.
3. Optionally composite the pieces into one sheet, captioned with the geometry of each
   region, so a multi-region check costs one follow-up read rather than several.

dsh-crop-zoom README · Limits：- **Local files only.** Remote URLs are not fetched; that keeps the tool from becoming an
  outbound request channel on the model's behalf.
- Output is always PNG.
- 8 regions and 16× per call.
- Sheet captions are ASCII; non-Latin caption text depends on the fonts fontconfig
  exposes to librsvg, so put non-ASCII descriptions in the region `label` rather than
  expecting them on the image.

dsh-crop-zoom README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm test        # core geometry suite + plugin contract suite
```

`test/run.mjs` builds its own synthetic image and asserts exact output geometry.
`test/plugin.mjs` exercises `apply()` against a stub `ctx` and checks that a throwing
registry cannot escape.

dsh-crop-zoom README · dsh-crop-zoom：**把图上的小字裁出来放大，让模型真的能认。**

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（`dsh`）插件，注册一个 `crop_zoom` 工具；
同一套引擎也提供独立命令行。
[English →](README.md)

- 纯本地图像处理 —— 不联网、不调用模型、不含 OCR 引擎。
- 只有一个依赖 `sharp`（libvips），并且**延迟加载**：原生模块坏了也只会让一次工具调用失败，不会让整个 harness 起不来。
- Node ≥ 22，MIT。

---

dsh-crop-zoom README · 它解决什么问题：一张 1920×1080 的截图**不是**以 1920×1080 送到模型面前的。中途会被降采样，于是 10–11px
的道具名笔画已经粘在一起 —— 再看一遍原图也没用，那些像素已经没了。

同一个结算界面上的四处读数，全都以同样的方式读错：

| 实际印的 | 读出来的 | 为什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `03重型盔` | `D3重型盔` | 11px 时 `0` 和 `D` 共用一条左竖 |
| `BT6重型` | `B16重型` | `T` 和前一个 `B` 粘成一个字 |
| `1000戰地包` | `100D戰地包` | 四位数字并成三位加一个字母 |
| `鎏影權鋒` | `盜影權杖` | `鎏` 下面的「金」塌成了「皿」的样子 |

把这些区域**先裁出来放大再看**，字就清清楚楚。顺序不能颠倒，而且比把整张截图再送一遍便宜得多。

dsh-crop-zoom README · 作为 dsh 插件安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-crop-zoom     # 从 registry 装
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-crop-zoom   # 从本地目录装
```

然后重启应用。模型就多了一个 `crop_zoom` 工具，而且它的 schema 会随**每一次请求**重新送到模型面前。
section: 作为 dsh 插件安装

text:
dsh-crop-zoom README · 作为命令行安装：```bash
npm install -g dsh-crop-zoom
crop-zoom -i shot.png -r 1178,588,64,24 -s 16 -o label.png
```

dsh-crop-zoom README · 参数：| 名称 | 类型 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | — | 源图绝对路径。必填。 |
| `regions` | array | — | 1–8 个区域，按拼图顺序。必填。每项 `{x, y, width, height, label?}`，坐标是**源图像素**。 |
| `scale` | integer | — | 整数放大倍数，1–16。不填则由 `target` 推导。 |
| `target` | integer | `1600` | 无 `scale` 时，把区域长边放大到这么多像素，上限 16×。 |
| `mode` | enum | `bicubic` | `bicubic` \| `nearest` \| `lanczos` \| `mitchell`。 |
| `sheet` | boolean | `true` | 把所有区域拼成一张带标注的 PNG；`false` 则每个区域各写一个文件。 |
| `outPath` | string | 临时目录 | 输出位置，必须以 `.png` 结尾。 |
| `previewWidth` | integer | — | 坐标是在降采样预览图上量的时填它：填预览图的像素宽度，所有坐标自动换算到原图。 |

dsh-crop-zoom README · 参数：`bicubic` 保留字形轮廓，是合适的默认值。`nearest` 复制整块像素，能把 `0` 和 `D` 分开 ——
两者互补，某个字还是定不下来时，两种都看一眼。

dsh-crop-zoom README · 命令行：```
crop-zoom -i <image> -r <x,y,w,h> [-r <x,y,w,h> ...] [options]

-i, --image <path>        源图（PNG / JPEG / WebP / AVIF / TIFF / GIF）
  -r, --region <x,y,w,h>    要放大的区域，最多重复 8 次

dsh-crop-zoom README · 实现：1. 源图一次性解码进内存。区域边界按**显示尺寸**（EXIF 旋转之后）校验，所以竖拍照片按你看到的方向裁。
2. 逐区域 `extract`，再按**整数倍**用选定核 `resize` —— 整数放大不会在你正要读的笔画上引入重采样痕迹。
3. 需要时把各块合成一张图，每块上方标注几何信息，这样多区域核对只要再读一次。

dsh-crop-zoom README · 限制：- **只处理本地文件。** 不会去抓远程 URL，避免这个工具变成替模型发外部请求的通道。
- 输出固定为 PNG。
- 每次最多 8 个区域、16× 放大。
- 拼图上的标注是 ASCII；非拉丁标注能不能画出来取决于 fontconfig 给 librsvg 暴露了哪些字体，
  所以中文描述请写在区域 `label` 里，别指望它出现在图上。

dsh-crop-zoom README · 开发：```bash
npm install
npm test        # 核心几何测试 + 插件契约测试
```

`test/run.mjs` 自己合成测试图，断言精确的输出尺寸。
`test/plugin.mjs` 用桩 `ctx` 跑 `apply()`，并验证注册表抛错也不会逸出。
